mechanism_narrative: A negative 1-month change in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals active monetary easing, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in FEDFUNDS decline periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate profit expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in UNRATE > 5.5% periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals broad consumer demand deterioration, reducing corporate revenue growth expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in triggered instances (both HOUST and RSAFS declining) are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (GDPC1 annualized growth > 2.5%), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals imminent manufacturing slowdown, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in late-cycle INDPRO decline periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A positive 1-month change in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals strengthening labor market conditions, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in PAYEMS growth periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in year-over-year CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 2.0% signals accelerating inflation, increasing monetary tightening risk and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in CPIAUCSL > 2.0% periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals broad economic slowdown, reducing corporate profit growth expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in triggered instances (HOUST declining and UNRATE rising) are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3% y/y), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals stagflation risk, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in high-inflation INDPRO decline periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
